metadata.title: Ornate Monochromatic Portrait with Gradient Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white studio portrait of a female figure wearing intricate, beaded, and jeweled attire, overlaid with tall, condensed typography featuring a vertical pink-to-transparent gradient.
coreVisualRelationships: The central figure's face is the primary focal point, framed by a complex jeweled headpiece.
The pink gradient text creates a vibrant color contrast against the desaturated background.
The verticality of the condensed font mimics the vertical lines of the headpiece chains.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic grayscale photography for the subject.
High-contrast lighting with deep shadows and bright highlights on metallic textures.
Soft pink vertical gradient applied to all text.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, close-up head and shoulders shot filling the majority of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large floral-shaped jewel on the forehead.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes to the forehead jewel, down to the hand near the chin, then outward to the large display text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, vignetted background providing a clean stage for the detailed subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Grayscale (Black to White) for the photographic base.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft magenta/pink gradient used exclusively for typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the image; low saturation overall except for the vibrant text accents.
paletteRestrictions: No color in the photographic elements.
Text must use a two-tone vertical gradient.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow).
Uniform stroke weight with slight rounding on corners.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' has a very tight, vertical curve.
The 'G' and 'C' have flattened sides to maintain the condensed profile.

composition.overlap: behind the subject's hand/hair but over the face

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Consistent use of a single condensed sans-serif family in different scales.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the tall, narrow, and slightly rounded sans-serif aesthetic.
Provides the necessary clean, condensed uppercase structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a woman with dark hair, wearing an elaborate jeweled headpiece with a central flower motif and a heavily beaded metallic top. The lighting should be dramatic with a dark vignetted background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed uppercase sans-serif text. Apply a vertical gradient from soft pink at the top to dark magenta/transparent at the bottom. Place the main text across the middle and secondary text in the bottom left.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochromatic except for the text?
Is the text ultra-condensed and tall?
Does the text feature a vertical pink gradient?
Is the headpiece the most detailed element of the image?

adjustableVariables: Level of vignetting in the background

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the eyes and jewelry
avoid: Muddled gray tones without true blacks

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast clarity in the beaded garment.
Ensure the pink gradient on the text is smooth and vertical.
Verify the font is sufficiently condensed to match the reference style.
Confirm the background is dark and non-distracting.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Glamour Portrait + Ornate Metallic Accessories + Ultra-Condensed Gradient Typography.
